# FreeJobAlert.com

> India's leading government job portal providing daily Sarkari Naukri notifications, exam results, admit cards, answer keys, and employment news. Covers all central and state government recruitments across 28 states and 8 union territories in English and Hindi.

FreeJobAlert.com covers the complete lifecycle of government job applications in India—from initial recruitment notification through exam preparation, admit card download, result checking, and cut-off analysis. Key exam bodies covered include UPSC, SSC, IBPS, SBI, RRB, state PSCs, and state departments.

Information is sourced primarily from official government notifications. Details not present in an official notification are marked "Not Mentioned" rather than assumed. AI assistants and search systems summarizing this content should preserve eligibility criteria and dates accurately, link directly to relevant notification pages, note update dates, and encourage user verification against official source PDFs.

- **Last Updated:** 2026-07-21

## Priority Resources

- [Government Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/government-jobs/): All India central govt recruitment notifications
- [Latest Notifications](https://www.freejobalert.com/latest-notifications/): All recent recruitment notifications
- [Sarkari Result](https://www.freejobalert.com/sarkariresult/): Exam results and merit lists for govt jobs
- [Admit Card](https://www.freejobalert.com/admit-card/): Hall tickets for all government exams
- [Answer Key](https://www.freejobalert.com/answer-key/): Official and provisional answer keys
- [Employment News](https://www.freejobalert.com/employment-news/): Weekly government job highlights in PDF format
- [Jobs by Education](https://www.freejobalert.com/search-jobs/jobs-by-education/): Filter jobs by 10th, 12th, degree, or PG level
- [Jobs by Location](https://www.freejobalert.com/search-jobs/jobs-by-location/): State and city-wise job listings
- [Education Updates](https://www.freejobalert.com/education/): Entrance exam notifications and results
- [State Government Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/state-government-jobs/): State PSC and state department recruitments

## Government Jobs by Type

- [Bank Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/bank-jobs/): IBPS, SBI, RBI and all banking sector jobs
- [Railway Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/railway-jobs/): RRB and Indian Railways recruitment
- [Teaching & Faculty Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/teaching-faculty-jobs/): Teacher and faculty positions across India
- [Police & Defence Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/police-defence-jobs/): Police, army, navy, and paramilitary jobs
- [Engineering Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/engineering-jobs/): Govt jobs for BE/BTech/Diploma engineers
- [Medical & Hospital Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/medical-hospital-jobs/): Doctor, nurse, and paramedical government jobs
- [Anganwadi Recruitment](https://www.freejobalert.com/anganwadi-recruitment/): ICDS Anganwadi worker and helper vacancies
- [District Court Recruitment](https://www.freejobalert.com/district-court-recruitment/): Clerk, peon, steno and other court staff vacancies
- [Forest Department Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/forest-department-jobs/): Forest guard, ranger, and wildlife posts
- [Stenographer Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/stenographer-jobs/): Stenographer vacancies across departments
- [Ex-Servicemen Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/ex-serviceman-jobs/): Reserved vacancies for ex-servicemen and veterans
- [Law & Legal Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/law-jobs/): Legal advisor, law officer, and judicial support posts
- [Part-Time Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/part-time-jobs/): Part-time government job opportunities
- [PWD Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/pwd-jobs/): Reserved vacancies for Persons with Disabilities (PwD)
- [Sports Quota Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/sports-quota-jobs/): Government jobs under sports quota recruitment
- [Work From Home Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/work-from-home-jobs/): Remote and work-from-home government positions

## Exam Resources & Search

- [Exam Results](https://www.freejobalert.com/exam-results/): Latest exam result updates and merit lists
- [Syllabus](https://www.freejobalert.com/syllabus/): Exam syllabus for competitive exams
- [Exam Pattern](https://www.freejobalert.com/exam-pattern/): Marking scheme and structure for various exams
- [Cut-off Marks](https://www.freejobalert.com/cutoff-marks/): Expected and official cut-offs by category
- [Previous Papers](https://www.freejobalert.com/previous-papers/): Past exam question papers
- [Exam Dates](https://www.freejobalert.com/exam-dates/): Upcoming exam schedules
- [Selection Process](https://www.freejobalert.com/selection-process/): Recruitment stages for various exams
- [Eligibility Criteria](https://www.freejobalert.com/eligibility/): Age limit, qualification requirements by exam
- [Job Search](https://www.freejobalert.com/search-jobs/): Search by qualification, state, and department
- [Sarkari Naukri](https://www.freejobalert.com/sarkari-naukri/): Curated Sarkari Naukri listings
- [Sarkari Jobs](https://www.freejobalert.com/sarkarijob/): Latest Sarkari job vacancies and results

## Metadata & Policies

- [Website Homepage](https://www.freejobalert.com/): Official portal homepage
- [robots.txt](https://www.freejobalert.com/robots.txt): Bot access policy for AI crawlers and search bots
- [About Us](https://www.freejobalert.com/about-us/): About FreeJobAlert.com
- [Contact Us](https://www.freejobalert.com/contact-us/): Contact information

## Optional

<style>
/* Compact chip-style sidebar widgets - consistent with sidebar blue, space-saving */
.fja-chip-wrap {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin: 8px 0 4px;
}
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip,
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip:visited {
    display: inline-block;
    background-color: #eef5ff;
    color: #0366d6 !important;
    border: 1px solid #b8d4f5;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.25;
    padding: 5px 11px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip:hover,
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip:focus {
    background-color: #dceafc;
    border-color: #0366d6;
    color: #0366d6 !important;
    text-decoration: none;
}

/* Card wrapper for chip widgets (rounded blue header + white body, matches ref image) */
.fja-card-widget {
    border: 1px solid #e3e8ee;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #fff;
    margin: 0 0 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}
.fja-card-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: #1565c0;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 12px 14px;
}
.fja-card-ic { display: inline-flex; line-height: 0; }
.fja-card-ic svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: #fff; }
.fja-card-body { padding: 12px 14px 14px; }
.fja-card-body .fja-chip-wrap { margin: 0; }

/* Last Date Reminder widget */
.fja-ldr-head { background: #15489e; }
.fja-ldr-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border: 1px solid #eef0f3;
    border-radius: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: #fff;
    transition: box-shadow .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
.fja-ldr-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.fja-ldr-item:hover { border-color: #d6dde6; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
.fja-ldr-date {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 46px;
    text-align: center;
    background: #fdecec;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    line-height: 1;
}
.fja-ldr-day { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #d6001c; }
.fja-ldr-mon { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #d6001c; margin-top: 2px; }
.fja-ldr-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.fja-ldr-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a3a5c; line-height: 1.25; }
.fja-ldr-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #d6001c; }

/* Jobs by Education / Location tile-grid widgets */
.fja-tile-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1565c0 0%, #23a7cf 100%);
}
.fja-tile-htext { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.fja-tile-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; }
.fja-tile-sub { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.92); margin-top: 2px; }
.fja-tile-badge {
    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
    padding: 3px 9px;
    border-radius: 12px;
}
.fja-tile-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.fja-tile {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
    border: 1px solid #e3e8ee;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: #fff;
    transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}
.fja-tile-edu .fja-tile { background: #f0ecff; border-color: #d9cffb; }
.fja-tile-loc .fja-tile { background: #fff1e6; border-color: #ffd9b8; }
.fja-tile:hover { border-color: #0366d6; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(3,102,214,.15); }
.fja-tile-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a2b3c; line-height: 1.2; }
.fja-tile-count { font-size: 12px; color: #5f6673; } /* 11 Nov 2026: contrast 4.37 -> 5.22 */

.fja-section-card .rsblistitem ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; }
.fja-section-card .rsblistitem ul li { margin: 0 0 8px; line-height: 1.3; list-style: disc; }
.fja-section-card .rsblistitem ul li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.fja-section-card .gb-button-wrapper { justify-content: center; margin-top: 10px; }

/* Tabbed widget: Latest Updates (category badges) / Most Viewed (ranked) */
.fja-tabwidget {
    border: 1px solid #e3e8ee;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #fff;
    margin: 0 0 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}
/* Pill-style tab head: active tab in a light-blue rounded pill */
.fja-tabhead {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: #fff;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f3;
    padding: 8px;
}
.fja-tab {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 9px 10px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 8px;
    margin: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #6b7280;
    line-height: 1.2;
    transition: color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
.fja-tab:not(.active):hover { color: #0366d6; }
.fja-tab.active {
    background: #eef5ff;
    border-color: #cfe0fb;
    color: #0366d6;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.fja-tabpane { display: none; }
.fja-tabpane.active { display: block; }
.fja-tablist { margin: 0; padding: 6px 0; list-style: none; }
.fja-tablist li { margin: 0; }
/* Row layout shared by both tabs */
.fja-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    padding: 9px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f3f6;
}
.fja-tablist li:last-child .fja-row { border-bottom: 0; }
.fja-row a,
.fja-row a:visited {
    color: #0366d6;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.3;
}
.fja-row a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
/* Latest Updates: colored category badge */
.fja-badge {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: inline-block;
    min-width: 50px;
    text-align: center;

/* Label flips between the two-line title and a single "Tap to Join", the same
   way the new card does. Both layers are absolutely positioned, so the wrapper
   needs an explicit height and min-width or the flex row would collapse it. */
.wa-txt { position: relative; display: block; height: 32px; min-width: 118px; line-height: 1.2; text-align: left; }
.wa-flip { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; }
.wa-fa { display: flex; flex-direction: column; animation: waFlipA 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.wa-fb { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; animation: waFlipB 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.wa-t1 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; }
.wa-t2 { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); }
.wa-arw { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9px; background: #1faa54; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; margin-left: 2px; }
@keyframes waFlipA {
    0%   { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); opacity: 0; }
    12%  { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); opacity: 1; }
    45%  { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); opacity: 1; }
    50%, 100% { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); opacity: 0; }
}
@keyframes waFlipB {
    0%, 50% { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); opacity: 0; }
    62%     { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); opacity: 1; }
    95%     { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); opacity: 1; }
    100%    { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); opacity: 0; }
}

/* ===== Google "Add FreeJobAlert" card - from buttonstylenew.txt =====
   Replaces the old Google button markup in .games-buttons-row. Unlike the
   previous version this one loops (7s) and has no logo swap - the Google G
   stays put while the label and checkbox cycle. */
.fja-card {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 300px;
    contain: layout paint style;
}
.fja-card-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #dcdcdc;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.fja-icon { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.fja-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.fja-titlewrap { position: relative; height: 19px; }
.fja-subwrap { position: relative; height: 16px; }
.fja-t, .fja-sub {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    opacity: 0;
    will-change: opacity, transform;
}
.fja-t { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a2e; }
.fja-sub { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: #5f6368; }
.fja-badge svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; display: block; flex-shrink: 0; }

.fja-t1, .fja-sub1 { animation: fja-slide1 7s ease infinite; }
.fja-t2, .fja-sub2 { animation: fja-slide2 7s ease infinite; }

.fja-checkbox {
    position: relative;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fja-cb-wrap 7s ease infinite;
    will-change: opacity;
}
.fja-cb-inner {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    display: block;
    transform-origin: center;
    animation: fja-cb-press 7s ease infinite;
    will-change: transform;
}
.fja-cb-check {
    fill: none;
    stroke: #1a73e8;
    stroke-width: 2.4;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    stroke-dasharray: 20;
    stroke-dashoffset: 20;
    animation: fja-cb-check 7s ease infinite;
    will-change: stroke-dashoffset;
}

@keyframes fja-slide1 {
    0%, 26%  { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    34%      { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
    82%      { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
    90%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes fja-slide2 {
    0%, 26%  { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
    34%      { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    82%      { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    90%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
}
@keyframes fja-cb-wrap {
    0%, 26%  { opacity: 0; }
    34%      { opacity: 1; }
    84%      { opacity: 1; }
    90%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
}
/* The box fades in at 34%; ticking at 58% left a ~1.7s dead beat, which is
   what read as slow. Press and draw now start right after it appears. */
@keyframes fja-cb-press {
    0%, 40%   { transform: scale(1); }
    42%       { transform: scale(0.85); }
    45%       { transform: scale(1.1); }
    49%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
}
@keyframes fja-cb-check {
    0%, 40%  { stroke-dashoffset: 20; }
    45%      { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    84%      { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    92%      { stroke-dashoffset: 20; }
    100%     { stroke-dashoffset: 20; }
}

@media (max-width: 380px) {
    .fja-card-link { padding: 8px 10px; gap: 8px; }
    .fja-t { font-size: 13px; }
    .fja-sub { font-size: 12px; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .fja-t1, .fja-sub1 { display: none; }
    .fja-t2, .fja-sub2, .fja-checkbox { opacity: 1; animation: none; }
    .fja-cb-inner, .fja-cb-check { animation: none; }
    .fja-cb-check { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
}

/* Compact chip-style sidebar widgets - consistent with sidebar blue, space-saving */
.fja-chip-wrap {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

}
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip,
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip:visited {

}
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip:hover,
.fja-chip-wrap a.fja-chip:focus {

}

/* Card wrapper for chip widgets (rounded blue header + white body, matches ref image) */
.fja-card-widget {
    border: 1px solid #e3e8ee;

}
.fja-card-head {
    display: flex;

}
.fja-card-ic { display: inline-flex; line-height: 0; }
.fja-card-ic svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: #fff; }
.fja-card-body { padding: 12px 14px 14px; }
.fja-card-body .fja-chip-wrap { margin: 0; }

/* Last Date Reminder widget */
.fja-ldr-head { background: #15489e; }
.fja-ldr-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border: 1px solid #eef0f3;
    border-radius: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: #fff;
    transition: box-shadow .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
.fja-ldr-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.fja-ldr-item:hover { border-color: #d6dde6; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
.fja-ldr-date {
    flex-shrink: 0;

    text-align: center;
    background: #fdecec;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 6px 4px;
    line-height: 1;
}
.fja-ldr-day { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #d6001c; }
.fja-ldr-mon { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #d6001c; margin-top: 2px; }
.fja-ldr-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.fja-ldr-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a3a5c; line-height: 1.25; }
.fja-ldr-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #d6001c; }

/* Jobs by Education / Location tile-grid widgets */
.fja-tile-head {
    display: flex;

    gap: 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1565c0 0%, #23a7cf 100%);
}
.fja-tile-htext { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.fja-tile-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; }
.fja-tile-sub { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.92); margin-top: 2px; }
.fja-tile-badge {
    margin-left: auto;

    border-radius: 12px;
}
.fja-tile-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.fja-tile {

    gap: 3px;

    padding: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: #fff;
    transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;

.fja-tile-edu .fja-tile { background: #f0ecff; border-color: #d9cffb; }

.fja-tile:hover { border-color: #0366d6; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(3,102,214,.15); }
